page.notes: Arabic, Greek and Hebrew passages are transcribed approximately; each word that could not be read with certainty is marked [?]. The Arabic in the first paragraph ("nomen ..."), the Arabic and Greek in the second paragraph ("qui ...", "μετεμψύχωσιν"), and the Arabic gloss "i. e. ... ejus qui me interfecit" are doubtful. The right-hand marginal note is "* In" with Arabic, read as "وفي ... In". The catchword "vetuit" is doubtful and may read "venit". The line "Credi hoc" is cut off at the column edge. The reference "T" below the column is read as the signature.
